trial_court: Court of learned Additional District Judge (Matrimonial Cases) Jammu, Matrimonial Case No. 357 of 2020
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner's divorce petition under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is pending before the trial court. Respondent has filed a divorce petition against petitioner in the same court to create an occasion for inflicting torture and harassment.

legal_principles.principle: A petition under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 can be transferred to another court.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, this application is allowed. The petition, i.e., Matrimonial Case (Civil) No. 357 of 2020 (CNR No. JKJM020032342020) under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 titled Matrimonial Case (Civil) No. 357 of 2020.

legal_principles.principle: A respondent who fails to file objections or appear in a proceeding may not be heard on the merits.
legal_principles.held: Despite service neither objections have been filed nor has anyone caused appearance on behalf of respondent.

outcome.final_order: Petition under Section 13 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is transferred from Jammu to Kathua.
